props.title: Understanding What a Project Will Cost
props.subtitle: Pricing and fees
props.challengeSummary: You're asking what we charge and want to know what working together might involve.

props.title: Scope Before Price
props.content: We'd start with the outcome you're after and the audience you need to reach, then shape the work around that rather than starting from a fixed package.

final.explanation: Price depends on scope, so we don't quote figures here. Nothing we retrieved speaks to pricing, so we haven't shown client work. The first step is a short conversation about what you're trying to achieve, and our Strategy Lead can scope that with you.
